mapper.sql: select f.id, f.name, f.url, f.url_hash, f.enabled, f.last_fetch_time, f.last_fetch_count, f.fetch_error, f.consecutive_failures, f.del_flag, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.update_by, f.update_time, f.remark from px_web_rss_feed f
mapper.select:
where f.id = #{id} and f.del_flag = '0'
and f.create_by = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into px_web_rss_feed(name, url, url_hash, enabled, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{name}, #{url}, #{urlHash}, #{enabled}, '0', #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark})
mapper.select: where f.url_hash = #{urlHash} and f.create_by = #{userId} and f.del_flag = '0' limit 1
